narrative_purpose: The core contrast of the chapter: a tidal sac that fills and empties through one door and traps stale air, beside a one-way flow-through tube whose surface always meets fresh air.
subject: A flat schematic split into two halves side by side. LEFT half: a single rounded sac with one opening on its left; a double-headed arrow at the opening showing air going in AND out the same door; a shaded dim pocket of trapped stale air at the blind right end of the sac. RIGHT half: a straight open-ended tube; a single arrow entering the left end and a single arrow leaving the right end, all one direction; a clean bright band along the tube wall showing the always-fresh exchange surface.
scene: Empty dark space background, a faint thin vertical divider between the two halves, only the sac and the tube and their arrows.
camera: Flat head-on schematic view, no perspective, no 3D.
light: Flat even lighting; arrows and the fresh-surface band glow on their own; the trapped stale pocket is dim and dull.
palette: Near-black background; left (tidal) side uses dull amber for the double arrow and a murky amber dim pocket; right (one-way) side uses bright cyan one-way arrows and a clean teal fresh-surface band.
style: Clean elegant infographic of thin glowing lines and arrows, like a vector schematic.

composition: Two balanced halves side by side, divider down the centre, the tidal sac left, the flow-through tube right.
